claims.statement: The EU Batteries Regulation requires passports from 18 February 2027 for EV, LMT, and industrial batteries above 2 kWh.
The Commission describes the passport as decentralized and maintained by the responsible economic operator.

contrary_evidence: Open interoperability requirements constrain lock-in and may make basic hosting commoditized.
Large manufacturers may build the capability internally before the deadline.

economics.acquisition_route: Unvalidated hypothesis: acquire customers through Polish battery distributors, customs advisers, and storage installers.
economics.founder_net_worth_path: Unvalidated hypothesis: 300 importers and 120,000 annual passports could support a 5 million PLN founder net-worth path in seven to nine years without double-counting retained earnings.
economics.founder_time: Unvalidated hypothesis: an automated pilot can remain below 20 founder hours weekly.
economics.gross_margin_basis: Unvalidated hypothesis: software-led delivery could reach 75% gross margin, and every commercial number including capital_required_pln is hypothetical.
economics.payback: Unvalidated hypothesis: recover acquisition cost within six months after five activated batches.
economics.pricing: Unvalidated hypothesis: charge 400 PLN per activated passport plus 1,200 PLN per importer monthly.
economics.retention_or_repeat: Unvalidated hypothesis: lifecycle updates and new battery batches create recurring usage.

fingerprint.compounding_advantage: A permissioned component-data graph and exception library improve each subsequent onboarding
fingerprint.distribution_mechanism: Distributor and customs-adviser referrals plus targeted importer outreach
fingerprint.offer_and_business_model: Managed passport onboarding, hosting, registry integration, and update subscription
fingerprint.payer_and_paid_event: The responsible economic operator pays when a passport is activated and maintained
fingerprint.problem_trigger: A covered battery is prepared for EU market placement without a compliant persistent record

founder_fit: The work uses data engineering, AI-assisted document extraction, and Polish renewable-industry access.
A narrow importer pilot can run part-time without camera-led distribution.
risks: Incorrect source data could create customer liability that contract terms do not fully contain.
Standards and delegated acts may change the implementation workload.

structure.control_point: Passport creation, registry submission, and lifecycle update workflow
structure.critical_dependency: Complete manufacturer data and continuing alignment with EU technical standards

thesis: Operate the persistent battery-passport record for CEE storage importers that lack an internal compliance data team.
title: CEE Battery Passport Custodian
uncertainties: Importer willingness to delegate the legally sensitive record is unverified.
All commercial numbers including capital_required_pln are unvalidated hypotheses.
